name: Tensor Ventures
decision_note: Prague deep-tech pre-seed to Series A VC (Luxembourg Fund I; second fund, the pre-seed Tensor Ventures Co-investment Fund, launched Oct 2024 with a EUR 20m EIF/NPO commitment towards a EUR 50m target); led Pointee's seed (April 2026) and Repsense's round (Dec 2025) and joined Valka.ai's pre-seed (Feb 2026).

funds.name: Tensor Ventures Co-investment Fund (second fund; EIF commitment from the National Recovery Plan)

evidence.quote: Tensor Ventures explores deep tech innovation's frontiers & invests in uncharted territories.
We embrace inevitable tectonic shifts; the rise of AI, Quantum Revolution, Computational Biotech or Sustainable Tech.
We participate in Seed and Series A rounds.

As a financial market participant, Tensor Ventures GP S.à r.l (the “GP”), as general partner and registered AIFM of Tensor Ventures Fund I (the “Fund”) makes the following disclosure in accordance with SFDR regulation.
Nejprve začali se svými penězi, pak v roce 2017 otevřeli první fond, do něhož získali dvacet milionů eur, a tento kapitál již rozinvestovali do dvacítky startupů.
Vznikne tak projekt koinvestičního fondu zvaný Tensor Ventures Co-investment Fund, který cílí na celkovou velikost až 50 milionů eur (zhruba 1,25 miliardy korun)
Investici vedl český fond Tensor Ventures, ke kterému se přidal Seed Starter České i Slovenské spořitelny.
Startup v pre-seedovém kole získal rekordní investici 12 milionů eur, tedy necelých 300 milionů korun, a to od tuzemských fondů J&T Ventures, Tensor Ventures
Investiční kolo vedl český deeptech fond Tensor Ventures, přidaly se Seed Starter České spořitelny a stávající litevští investoři BSV Ventures a Coinvest Capital.
Konkrétně jde o české fondy Tensor Ventures, Lighthouse Ventures, Moondust Ventures, 22 Hor Invest a také zahraniční BSV Ventures.
Zaměřovat se budou na financování digitálních startupů v nejranější fázi vývoje, která se označuje jako pre-seed.

The European Investment Fund has committed EUR 20 million to the second fund, highlighting growing institutional interest in deep-tech investments, particularly in early-stage startups developing complex and high-potential technologies.

Tensor Ventures, a deep-tech fund focused on quantum technologies, biotech and other advanced sectors, has officially launched a new fund aiming to raise EUR 50 million, following the conclusion of its first investment period, as reported by Startup Kitchen.

analyst_notes: Structure: Fund I is Tensor Ventures Fund I SCSp with Tensor Ventures GP S.à r.l. as general partner and registered AIFM (Luxembourg, per the site's SFDR legal disclosure e4); GLEIF lists 'Tensor Ventures Fund I' with LEI 984500BF974QT5DAK471 (Luxembourg RCS B277418, active); no LEI/RCS found for the GP, so its registry_id is null; the team and Czech contact are in Prague (Karlín), and Tensor Ventures a.s. (IČO 06257241, Pernerova 635/57, Praha 8) is the Czech company of the founders - role not confirmed, marked 'other'. Other Tensor-named Czech companies at the same address (Tensor I. s.r.o. 17628504, Tensor Advisory s.r.o. 19987544, Tensor Warehouse s.r.o. 22245031) were not linked to the funds by any source and are not listed. Capital: Fund I EUR 20m opened in 2017 (CzechCrunch 2024-05-15) - the latest closed fund found; the Tensor Ventures Co-investment Fund (EIF / Czech National Recovery Plan RRF fund-of-funds, up to EUR 20m from EIF) targets up to EUR 50m - no close announcement found, so it is recorded as a target only. Ticket: the website states none; EUR 250k-1m is the CVCA self-reported profile (2020) - labelled self_reported. Geography 'EU, US' is likewise only self-reported (CVCA); observed deals are CZ, LT, NL. Stage: site says Seed and Series A; observed rounds also include pre-seed (QurieGen, Valka.ai, Edmund AI Feb 2025). Investment amounts are total round sizes: Pointee USD 1.4m seed led by Tensor; Valka.ai EUR 12m pre-seed led by Rockaway Ventures; Repsense (Lithuanian, platform 'Havel') EUR 1.1m led by Tensor; QurieGen EUR 2.2m pre-seed led by Tensor (amount and lead in adjacent sentences of the same article). [revision 2026-10-25 after review: (1) capital changed from EUR 20m latest_fund_size (Fund I, opened 2017 - no longer the current vehicle) to EUR 20m interim_close as of 2024-10-14 = the EIF commitment from the Czech National Recovery Plan to the second fund, the Tensor Ventures Co-investment Fund, officially launched in October 2024 with a EUR 50m target (The Quantum Insider 2024-10-14, e14/e15); a commitment is not a final close, and no close or total committed figure has been published, so the EIF amount is the only quotable committed capital (private LP money, e.g. Venture Club's EUR 1.3m reported by Vestbee in July 2024, not added because the receiving vehicle is not named). Fund events added: commitment EUR 20m and launch, both 2024-10-14 (dated by the article; before the activity window, so activity still rests on the deals). The two EUR 20m figures are different vehicles (Fund I size vs. EIF commitment to fund II); Quantum Insider gives Fund I as EUR 18.5m, CzechCrunch as EUR 20m. (2) stage_focus: pre_seed added - the co-investment fund is stated to finance digital startups at the pre-seed stage (CzechCrunch 2024-05-15, e13; the MPO release of 2024-05-14 says the same), consistent with the pre-seed deals QurieGen and Valka.ai.]
